thread:
max: FYI seeing a spike of 502s in eu1 hosted-api since 23:05 UTC. customer tenant=12345. traces show upstream "x-upstream-error: connection reset" and auth failures. trace=abc123
ops-bot: ALERT: edge-gateway 502 spike detected (eu1) — 12% error rate over 5m window. linked alert: https://ops.redwood/alerts/4582 :rotating_light:
clare: any repro steps or a curl sample? can you paste the request headers (sanitized)
max: here's a minimal repro i ran quickly:
```
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <rotated-token>' \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  'https://eu1.api.redwood.inference/v1/models'
# returns 502 with header: x-upstream-error: connection reset
```
jun: i'm seeing auth-cache evictions on eu1 auth cluster at the same timestamps. key-rotation triggered TTL refresh storms -> many auth lookups fallbacking to billing lookup. auth service shows burst of 429s and 5s timeouts to billing.
oliver: is this the same tenant from yesterday heavy-embeds?
max: not the same. tenant 12345 is doing lots of small concurrent requests (burst of ~200 qps) after client retried tokens. repro: spin up 100 concurrency GETs while rotating token -> reproduces 502s within ~30s.
clare: mitigation plan proposal:
1) enable stateless fallback for auth path for this tenant (avoid cache hop)
2) bump auth-cache TTL on eu1 canary (30s -> 300s) to stop stampede
3) add circuit-breaker for billing calls to fail fast
jun: rolling TTL bump to eu1 canary now, and enabling billing CB at service layer. pushing change in 2m -> will watch.
ops-bot: deploy job #23245 queued -> canary deploy finished: success.
max: post-canary metrics: 502 rate dropped from 12% -> 0.9% in 10m window. still seeing a handful of streaming 504s for long-lived connections. suspect keepalive/h2 pool exhaustion.
oliver: +1 to open eng-sre ticket to validate h2 pool sizes and connection windowing. i'll create postmortem stub and owner. :thumbsup:
clare: thanks all. next steps: follow-up with eng-sre (h2 pools), add a tenant-level retry/backoff doc for support, and run a controlled load test for token rotation scenario.
max: noted — i'll update customer and attach repro steps and short summary.
